top_signals.title: Goldman Sachs on Anthropic, India, Korea Opportunities
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Chief Regional Equity Strategist for Asia Pacific Timothy Moe says uncertainty and de-risking are weighing on the broader AI trade. Speaking with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin and Avril Hong, he also outlines the case for India, and explains why they prefer Korea over Taiwan. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: ‘More than just a game’: How GTA VI’s blockbuster launch fuels a booming content economy
top_signals.summary: GTA VI’s blockbuster launch is creating a wider economy around livestreams, social clips and high-volume content farms as millions tune in to watch others play.
